annotation.title_clean: National Program for Artificial Intelligence in Israel – Program and Snapshot, April 2025
annotation.title_en: National Program for Artificial Intelligence in Israel – Program and Snapshot, April 2025
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Israel National Program for Artificial Intelligence (Telem; Ministry of Innovation, Science and Technology; Innovation Authority)
named_instruments_referenced: Council of Europe Framework Convention on AI
annotation.summary_en: Israel's April 2025 National AI Program (2021–2026, about NIS 1B) combines a global AI landscape review with a five-objective strategy: infrastructure and talent, high-tech adoption, public-sector AI, geo-technological standing, and national preparedness. It favors sectoral, risk-based regulation, sandboxes and OECD alignment. It excludes defense and has almost no robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Five objectives: AI infrastructure, high-tech adoption, public sector AI, global geo-technological position, national-level preparedness
Sectoral, risk-based, incremental regulation aligned with OECD principles rather than horizontal AI law
Regulatory sandboxes, regulatory knowledge center, regulators forum and public-engagement forum
National AI-HPC compute infrastructure and Hebrew/Arabic language models
Privacy-preserving data access via virtual research rooms and PETs; defense AI excluded from scope
